name: Clear Station Catchment
summary: Darker coverage borders and translucent area fills while building stations.
description:
Enable the mod and place a station, add a roadside stop or configure station modules. Existing passenger and cargo stations, bus stations and roadside stops display darker coverage borders with a matching translucent fill.

Keeps the native passenger/cargo hues and line widths. Overlapping areas may appear darker. Coverage distances and service rules are unchanged, and the mod does not add light columns or alter building-zone colors. It supports vanilla stations and mods that use the normal station-building interface.

The enhancement applies to existing stations. New-station previews, station information windows and near-camera fading remain controlled by the game. More existing catchment areas may appear than the current vanilla tool normally shows. Leaving station construction restores normal display.

Cover art illustrates the function; actual appearance is determined by the game.

zh_CN.name: 清晰站点范围
zh_CN.summary: 建站时用同色调深色边界和半透明填充显示已有站点范围。
zh_CN.description:
启用模组后，建造车站、放置沿路停靠点或配置车站模块时，已有客运站、货运站、公交站和沿路停靠点会显示更深的范围边界与同色半透明填充。

保持原有客货色调和线宽，重叠区域可能更深。不改变实际服务半径和覆盖规则，不额外改变房屋分区配色或添加光柱。适用于原版站点及沿用原版站点建造界面的模组。

增强对象是已建成站点；新站预览、单独查看站点信息窗口和近景淡化仍由游戏控制。可能比原版当前工具显示更多已有站点范围，退出站点建造后恢复原版显示。

封面为功能示意，实际画面以游戏内为准。
